items.title: AstraZeneca Shares Drop, Bristol Myers Squibb’s Climb After Merger Talks Reports
items.summary: A potential deal between AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb would create a pharma giant with a combined market value of roughly $400 billion.

items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb Stock Soars on Report of $400 Billion Merger Talks With AstraZeneca
items.summary: The merger would be one of the biggest pharma deals ever. AstraZeneca’s market capitalization stood at $264 billion as of Friday’s close, while Bristol Myers Squibb had a total valuation of $133 billion.

items.title: Ratio Therapeutics secures $70m Series C funding for cancer radiotherapy
items.summary: The funding will advance its ATLAS trial, assessing lead candidate [Ac-225]RTX-2358, a FAP-targeted radiotherapeutic for advanced sarcomas.
